name: Five Nights at Sonic's: Solar Switchup
storyline: Chapter 1 takes place in 2015, at the same time as Five Nights at Sonic's. Blaze's Royal Bakey opens its doors and you're playing as a security guard on the night shift, Gardon the Koala. Throughout the week, Gardon survives against the clones of Blaze the Cat, Silver the Hedgehog, Marine the Raccoon and Cream the Rabbit in their twisted game of cat and mouse.
summary: An official followup to the original Five Nights at Sonic's series, taking place in the same continuity, but telling its own new story. The game is divided into chapters that are each their own subgame.
